adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces verifiable permission and filtering defects in the new `addGuestsHandler`. The variable `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed with `&&` (`(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`), which contradicts its name and will deny access to users who are admin-but-not-owner or owner-but-not-admin (lines in `addGuests.handler.ts` where it’s defined and then used in the `FORBIDDEN` check). Also, blacklist filtering lowercases the blacklist entries but compares them against the raw `guest` string (`blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`), allowing case-variant bypass (e.g., `Test@Example.com`) since guest emails are not normalized before comparison. These are correctness/security bugs exposed by the diff, independent of test coverage.
